tasks.dev: deno run -A npm:concurrently -r "deno task css:watch" "deno task client:watch" "deno desktop -A --conditions browser --hmr src/main.ts"
tasks.server: deno task assets:build && deno run -A --conditions browser --watch src/main.ts
tasks.assets:build: deno task client:build && deno task css:build
tasks.build: deno task assets:build && deno desktop -A --conditions browser --include static src/main.ts
tasks.build:server: deno task assets:build && deno compile -A --conditions browser --include static --output ./dist/server/pi-ui src/main.ts
tasks.css:build: deno run -A scripts/generate-basecoat-css.ts && deno run -A npm:@tailwindcss/cli -i src/ui/styles.css -o static/app.css --minify
tasks.css:watch: deno run -A scripts/generate-basecoat-css.ts && deno run -A npm:@tailwindcss/cli -i src/ui/styles.css -o static/app.css --watch --silent
tasks.check: deno check --conditions browser src/main.ts rolldown.config.ts && deno check --config deno.client.json --conditions browser src/client/workspace-review.ts src/client/pierre-worker.ts
